title: A duplicate and two late usage events on their way to the November invoice
captions: Event e7 says customer A made 300 API calls at 14:02 on 30 November. Its id is new, so the 300 calls go into November's total.
The sender did not get an answer, so it sends e7 again. Dedupe has seen the id e7 before and drops the copy. The total stays at 300.
Event e9 happened at 23:58 but arrives at 00:20 on 1 December. It is late, but inside the one-hour grace period, so it still counts for November.
At 01:00 the grace period ends. The November invoice is final with 500 calls. It will not change again.
Event e10 happened at 23:59 but arrives at 03:00. It is too late for the invoice. You keep it in the log and flag it for reconciliation, so a person or a rule decides what to do.
